payload.title: File:Saurornitholestes langstoni skeletal.png
payload.description_html:
Skeleton restoration of the dromaeosaurid Saurornitholestes langstoni, showing in white best known remains. The skull is based on the recent reconstruction by Currie & Evans (2019).

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Saurornitholestes langstoni

Sues, 1978

Late Cretaceous, Campanian epoch.

Dinosaur Park, Two Medicine, Oldman, Judith River, Foremost Formations; United States of America, Canada.

Specimens: RTMP 74.10.5 (holotype), MOR 660, ROM #? "Julieraptor", RTMP 88.121.39, UALVP 55700, dozens of other specimens.

Scale bar equals 25 cm, scaled as MOR 660.
